decisive_items: Cutaneous lesion biopsy: 'Ghost cells'—fat necrosis with saponification
1.9 × 1.7-cm mass in portal vein with extension to superior mesenteric vein
response.rationale: Skin biopsy showing ghost cells (fat necrosis with saponification) plus marked pancreatic enzyme elevation and a pancreatic head mass with vascular extension strongly indicate pancreatic cancer with panniculitis. Necrotizing pancreatitis lacks the specific cutaneous histology and chronic nodular presentation.

rejected.why: Elevated enzymes and pancreatic imaging are present, but the pathognomonic skin biopsy and nodular panniculitis favor pancreatic cancer-associated panniculitis over necrotizing pancreatitis.
